description: Add, modify and delete an IPA host using IPA API.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A description of this host.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force host name even if not in DNS. Choices: false true

parameters.name: force_creation
parameters.description: Create host if state=disabled or state=enabled but not present. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: fqdn
parameters.description: Full qualified domain name. Can not be changed as it is the unique identifier.

parameters.name: ip_address
parameters.description: Add the host to DNS with this IP address.

parameters.name: ipa_host
parameters.description: IP or hostname of IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_HOST is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_HOST and the value are not specified in the task, then DNS is used to try to discover the FreeIPA server. The relevant entry needed in FreeIPA is the ipa-ca entry. If neither the DNS entry, nor the environment IPA_HOST, nor the value are available in the task, then the default value is used. Default: "ipa.example.com"

parameters.name: ipa_pass
parameters.description: Password of administrative user. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PASS is used instead. Note that if the urllib_gssapi library is available, it is possible to use GSSAPI to authenticate to FreeIPA. If the environment variable KRB5CCNAME is available, the module uses this Kerberos credentials cache to authenticate to the FreeIPA server. If the environment variable KRB5_CLIENT_KTNAME is available, and KRB5CCNAME is not; the module uses this Kerberos keytab to authenticate. If GSSAPI is not available, the usage of ipa_pass is required.

parameters.name: ipa_port
parameters.description: Port of FreeIPA / IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PORT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PORT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 443

parameters.name: ipa_prot
parameters.description: Protocol used by IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PROT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PROT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: ipa_timeout
parameters.description: Specifies idle timeout (in seconds) for the connection. For bulk operations, you may want to increase this in order to avoid timeout from IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 10

parameters.name: ipa_user
parameters.description: Administrative account used on IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_USER is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_USER and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: "admin"

parameters.name: l
parameters.description: Host locality (for example Baltimore, MD).

parameters.name: mac_address
parameters.description: List of Hardware MAC address(es) off this host. If option is omitted MAC addresses are not checked nor changed. If an empty list is passed all assigned MAC addresses are removed. MAC addresses that are already assigned but not passed are removed.

parameters.name: ns_hardware_platform
parameters.description: Host hardware platform (for example Lenovo T61").

parameters.name: ns_host_location
parameters.description: Host location (for example Lab 2).

parameters.name: ns_os_version
parameters.description: Host operating system and version (for example Fedora 9).

parameters.name: random_password
parameters.description: Generate a random password to be used in bulk enrollment. Choices: false true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State to ensure. Choices: "absent" "disabled" "enabled" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: update_dns
parameters.description: If set true with state=absent, then removes DNS records of the host managed by FreeIPA DNS. This option has no effect for states other than absent. Choices: false true

parameters.name: user_certificate
parameters.description: List of Base-64 encoded server certificates. If option is omitted certificates are not checked nor changed. If an empty list is passed all assigned certificates are removed. Certificates already assigned but not passed are removed.

parameters.name: userclass
parameters.description: Host category (semantics placed on this attribute are for local interpretation).

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: This only applies if ipa_prot is https. If set to false, the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to false used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Ensure host is present
  community.general.ipa_host:
    name: host01.example.com
    description: Example host
    userclass: Server
    ip_address: 192.168.0.123
    locality: Baltimore, MD
    ns_host_location: Lab
    ns_os_version: CentOS 7
    ns_hardware_platform: Lenovo T61
    mac_address:
      - "08:00:27:E3:B1:2D"
      - "52:54:00:BD:97:1E"
    state: present
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Generate a random password for bulk enrolment
  community.general.ipa_host:
    name: host01.example.com
    description: Example host
    ip_address: 192.168.0.123
    state: present
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret
    random_password: true

- name: Ensure host is disabled
  community.general.ipa_host:
    name: host01.example.com
    state: disabled
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Ensure that all user certificates are removed
  community.general.ipa_host:
    name: host01.example.com
    user_certificate: []
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Ensure host is absent
  community.general.ipa_host:
    name: host01.example.com
    state: absent
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Ensure host and its DNS record is absent
  community.general.ipa_host:
    name: host01.example.com
    state: absent
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret
    update_dns: true

return_values.name: host
return_values.description: Host as returned by IPA API. Returned: always

return_values.name: host_diff
return_values.description: List of options that differ and would be changed. Returned: if check mode and a difference is found
